errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.network: Couldn't reach the kitchen. Check your internet and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.offline: You're offline. Some things won't work until you're back online.
errors.crashBody: It's not your fault. Reloading usually fixes it.

fields.displayNameHint: Shown on your recipes. You can change it later.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Welcome back! Sign in to save and share recipes.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.body: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to finish creating your account.
checkEmail.notArrived: Not there? Look in Spam or Promotions. If you already have an account, just sign in.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If that email has an account, a link is on its way. Check your inbox.

callback.confirmedBody: That link worked. Please sign in to continue.
callback.failedBody: It may have expired or already been used. Sign in, or ask for a new email.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match. Please check and try again.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Please confirm your email first. Look for our email in your inbox.
errors.userExists: This email already has an account. Try signing in instead.
errors.tooManyEmails: We've sent several emails already. Please wait a few minutes.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many tries. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.samePassword: That's your current password. Please choose a new one.
errors.generic: We couldn't do that right now. Please try again.
errors.passwordShort: Your password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.passwordLong: That password is too long (72 characters at most).

soon.title: Search is coming soon
soon.body: You'll be able to search in Malayalam, English or Manglish — like jeerakam, ജീരകം or cumin.

empty.title: Nothing saved yet
